name: p1-refused-opentitan-uart-serial-peer
description: Refusal sample: the UART target names the declaration-only behavior that adds a serial peer. The declaration normalizes and this host refuses it by name (unsupported-behavior-execution:serial_peer) before any F5 case runs.
notes: This scenario exists to record the named refusal of a serial peer, not to pass. The same target without the peer is configs/scenarios/p1-replacements/ip-opentitan-uart-local-tlul-f1f5.json, and that one runs F1-F5.
The refusal is raised by the behavior declaration layer (myfuzz.composition.inprocess_behavior.source_behavior) and names the group kind: unsupported-behavior-execution:serial_peer.
No serial frame is driven or observed by this scenario: the host has no serial driver, and that absence is the refusal.
